reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, goes through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and averageToBudget helpers, though #fixed detection uses a hand-written regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.

duplication.why: All exclusion rules live once in getBulkBudgetCategories; the only overlap is the private #fixed regex re-implementing tag parsing that shared/tags already provides.

placement.why: Selection rules sit in the bulk-selection helper in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts beside its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the requested actions, plus a release note; the one stray edit is an import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: One documented selection function with a single includeHiddenCategories flag and named predicates makes future rule changes a one-place edit; the custom tag regex could drift from the app's tag syntax.

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroupNote in budget/actions.ts parses '#fixed' with its own regex instead of shared/tags extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroupNote's regex is a reshaped version of the tag extraction in shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories's includeHidden is replaced by the requested includeHiddenCategories; template and #fixed rules are added as general filters, not per-caller special cases, and all six bulk actions call it.
